verdict.rationale: Brex is a business banking and payments platform, so receiving multi-currency payments through local account details is a fair question for it. The evidence only covers outbound payments (ACH, domestic wires, checks, "fast global payments") and a vague "banking in 120+ countries" claim. Nothing documents local receiving account details or multi-currency inbound collection.

support.subject: As a founder, I can receive payments using local account details in multiple currencies
